This kind of response is extremely disappointing and unprofessional, especially from a government institution that handles citizens’ life savings. Under the Government Savings Promotion Rules, 2018, post offices are required to assist investors in retrieving lost details so that duplicate certificates can be issued — but this branch has failed to follow even basic procedures.

It’s very frustrating to see such lack of cooperation and accountability in a matter involving public money. I sincerely hope senior officials from India Post take note of this issue and direct this post office to check their records and help me recover my rightful investment.
